name: HHF · W22b Flag posts from reviewable users

nodes.name: DEBUG: Manual trigger
nodes.notes:
This trigger is used for debugging the workflow. Arbitrary input data can be specified via the "pinned data".

Workflow runs from this trigger will reply debug information to a dedicated DM topic, and not raise flags. The delay that occurs during normal runs will be skipped.

parameters.query:
WITH
  target_user AS (
    SELECT
      users.id,
      users.ip_address,
      users.registration_ip_address
    FROM
      users
    WHERE
      users.id = :user_id
  ),
  user_ips AS (
    SELECT
      target_user.ip_address AS ip
    FROM
      target_user
    WHERE
      target_user.ip_address IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
      target_user.registration_ip_address AS ip
    FROM
      target_user
    WHERE
      target_user.registration_ip_address IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      users
    WHERE
      users.id != target_user.id
      AND (
        users.ip_address IN (
          SELECT
            user_ips.ip
          FROM
            user_ips
        )
        OR users.registration_ip_address IN (
          SELECT
            user_ips.ip
          FROM
            user_ips
        )
      )
  ) AS matching_account_count,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      users
    WHERE
      users.id != target_user.id
      AND (
        users.ip_address IN (
          SELECT
            user_ips.ip
          FROM
            user_ips
        )
        OR users.registration_ip_address IN (
          SELECT
            user_ips.ip
          FROM
            user_ips
        )
      )
      AND users.suspended_at IS NOT NULL
  ) AS matching_suspended_account_count
FROM
  target_user

nodes.notes: Under certain conditions the trigger output does not contain the post content. This occurs when the content is large: `"raw": "Value truncated (29532 bytes before truncation)"`. In this case, the Discourse Workflows system removes the `post.raw` key from the trigger output.

parameters.content:
This workflow flags posts from user accounts with characteristics that indicate review is warranted. Members of the "monitor" group are always flagged, with the post hidden until reviewed.

Adapted for HHF from per1234's workflow on meta.discourse.org (topic 414624, post 65): AI location comparison removed, suspicious-content bug fixed, null guards added, no 10-minute wait.
